title: Directions & Getting Lost
description: Asking the way, and understanding the answer — which is the harder half.

phrases.registerNotes: Blunt in English, completely normal in Japanese. Show a map alongside it.
Listening target — one of the three answers you'll actually get back.

phrases.japanese: 右に曲がってください
phrases.registerNotes: 右 = right, 左 (ひだり) = left. Learn them as a pair — mixing them up is the classic failure.
phrases.audioHint: みぎにまがってください

phrases.registerNotes: Opens the whole interaction. Japanese strangers will often walk you there rather than explain.

phrases.japanese: 左に曲がってください
phrases.registerNotes: The mirror of dir-03. Drill them together until neither needs a pause.
phrases.audioHint: ひだりにまがってください

phrases.registerNotes: ここ (here) / そこ (there, near you) / あそこ (over there). Usually delivered with a point.

phrases.japanese: この近くにコンビニはありますか

furigana.b: くにコンビニはありますか

phrases.romaji: kono chikaku ni konbini wa arimasu ka
phrases.english: Is there a convenience store near here?
phrases.registerNotes: この近くに〜はありますか is the pattern — swap in 駅, ATM, 薬局, トイレ.
phrases.audioHint: このちかくにコンビニはありますか

phrases.japanese: 歩いてどのくらいですか

furigana.b: いてどのくらいですか

phrases.english: How long does it take on foot?
phrases.registerNotes: Expect 十分ぐらい back. どのくらい asks about duration or distance.
phrases.audioHint: あるいてどのくらいですか

phrases.romaji: tsugi no shingō o migi desu
phrases.english: Right at the next traffic light.
phrases.registerNotes: Listening target. 信号 (traffic light) and 交差点 (intersection) are the two landmarks directions hang off.
phrases.audioHint: つぎのしんごうをみぎです

phrases.japanese: 地図を見せてもらえますか
phrases.english: Could you show me on a map?
phrases.registerNotes: The escape hatch when a spoken answer outruns you. Hold your phone out as you say it.
phrases.audioHint: ちずをみせてもらえますか
